findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: For any request involving a document from another tenant, `canReadDocument` now returns `true`, bypassing the previous tenant-equality check and permitting cross-tenant document access.

findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body:
Returning true unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to any tenant, bypassing the prior tenant-equality authorization check and enabling cross-tenant data exposure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
